registration.title: Back in the league after a European match with a week's rest
registration.what: In a league match, the expected margin moves 0.19 goals towards a side whose previous match was European, five or more days earlier.
registration.why: Found by looking on 2026-10-29 (experiments/rotation's follow-up): such sides beat the stored projection by +0.19 goals (+0.07 to +0.31, 779 side-matches). A lead among about 45 groups, so only live matches can test it (T-072).
registration.how: experiments/after_europe/DESIGN.md; the shift fixed from history in chosen.json; judged live by P19.
registration.hypothesis: Sides back in their league after a European match with five or more days' rest do better than the live model expects.
registration.success_criteria: P19 (experiments/prospective/PROTOCOLS.md): the confidence sequence's interval for the candidate minus the live model, on live matches from 2026-10-31, entirely below zero.
